On topic of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV)
g: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus first identified in 2001 in the Netherlands. Here's an overview:

Virus Type: HMPV is a member of the Pneumoviridae family, closely related to the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).

nodes.author: rwsanders
nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) are two distinct viruses, although they share some similarities:

Family: Both belong to the Pneumoviridae family but are different genera:
HMPV is in the Metapneumovirus genus.
RSV is in the Orthopneumovirus
